seeds.text: Find the exponent of 19 in the prime factorization of 21^3 - 2^3. Answer with a single non-negative integer.
seeds.human_solution: Set N = 21^3 - 2^3. First, 21 - 2 = 19 and v_19(19) = 1, so 19 divides 21 - 2 Neither 21 nor 2 is divisible by 19. Writing 21^3 - 2^3 = (21 - 2) · Σ_{i=0}^{3-1} 21^i 2^{3-1-i}, the valuation of the cofactor is governed by v_19(3) = 0. This gives v_19(N) = v_19(21 - 2) + v_19(3) = 1 + 0 = 1. Hence the answer is 1.
